+ 
+ ### Image Categories Migrated
+ 
+ #### Logos
+ - `fls-logo-yellow-black-bg.png` → `https://cdn.flsusa.shop/logos/fls-logo-yellow-black-bg.png`

+ ## Technical Benefits
+ 
+ ### Performance
+ - **Faster Loading**: CDN edge servers provide faster image delivery
+ - **Reduced Server Load**: Images served from dedicated CDN infrastructure
+ - **Global Distribution**: Improved performance for international users
+ 
+ ### Reliability
+ - **High Availability**: CDN provides redundancy and uptime guarantees
+ - **Scalability**: Can handle traffic spikes without performance degradation
+ - **Error Resilience**: Built-in fallback mechanisms
+ 
+ ### Email Client Compatibility
+ - **HTTPS Security**: Required by many modern email clients
+ - **Cross-Platform Support**: Better compatibility across email providers
+ - **Mobile Optimization**: Improved rendering on mobile devices
+ 
+ ## Implementation Details
+ 
+ ### URL Structure
+ ```
+ https://cdn.flsusa.shop/{category}/{filename}
+ 
+ Categories:
+ - logos/          # Company logos and branding
+ - products/       # Product images (shared, f3, signature)
+ - icons/          # Feature and UI icons
+ - lifestyle/      # Lifestyle and demonstration images
+ - backgrounds/    # Hero and section backgrounds
+ - social/         # Social media icons
+ ```
+

+ - Consistent naming conventions
+ - Logical categorization for easy management

+ 3. Alternative formats (WebP with fallbacks) are configured if needed
+ 4. Cache headers are properly configured
+ 5. SSL certificates are valid for the CDN domain
